summary: Completed full backend + frontend (desktop & mobile) testing for The Source landing page. Backend 7/7 pytest passing. Frontend flows mostly pass with one validation gap: the invalid-email path never reaches the custom [data-testid=contact-error] because native HTML5 <input type=email> validation blocks the submit event first — the JS validator (isValidEmail) is effectively dead code for that branch. Everything else — all 10 sections render, smooth-scroll nav (desktop & mobile), hero CTA, testimonial rotation + dot switching, contact happy path (POST /api/contact returns 200, persists in Mongo, success state shown), app store links, partner logos loading (200, naturalWidth>0), OG/Twitter meta tags & og-image.jpg (200), full-screen mobile glass menu with body scroll lock — works correctly.

minor.issue: Email field validated only by min_length=3 in Pydantic; a client bypassing frontend can submit garbage like 'x@y' and it will persist. Consider EmailStr for stricter validation.

ui_bugs.issue: Invalid-email UX: submitting 'notanemail' does NOT show [data-testid=contact-error]. Native browser type=email validation intercepts submit and pops a browser tooltip instead. The JS isValidEmail() check is unreachable for malformed emails. Fix: change <input type="email"> to type="text" (with inputMode="email"), OR add noValidate on the form so JS runs.

action_items: Fix contact form invalid-email UX so [data-testid=contact-error] displays instead of browser native tooltip (add noValidate on the <form> or change input type to text with inputMode=email).
(Optional hardening) Use pydantic EmailStr for /api/contact server-side email validation.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: ContactCreate.email uses only min_length constraint; no format validation. Use EmailStr from pydantic + email-validator.
ContactSection.jsx: Client uses type="email" AND JS validation — the two conflict; the JS branch showing 'Please enter a valid email' can never fire.
PartnersSection.jsx: Third-party image hosts are hardcoded (customer-assets-lqy194kg.emergentagent.net, eleven-public-cdn.elevenlabs.io). Consider self-hosting for reliability.

index.html: og:image uses %PUBLIC_URL%/og-image.jpg — resolves to relative /og-image.jpg. Social scrapers require absolute URL; consider making it absolute (e.g., https://source.example/og-image.jpg) for proper OG previews.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ contact row created during pytest and cleaned up. Frontend happy-path test also inserted a real submission (test_pw@example.com) via UI — left in DB for manual verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_contact.py covers /api/, /api/status, /api/contact (happy + 3 validation cases) and Mongo persistence. Frontend UI covered: 10 sections render, desktop nav (Problem/The Product/Different/Download) visible >=1024px with hamburger hidden, mobile hamburger opens full-screen glass overlay with 5 links, body scroll locked/restored, hero-cta and nav links smooth-scroll to correct sections, testimonial auto-rotate every ~6.5s + dot switching, download badges have correct apps.apple.com / play.google.com hrefs, partner logo pairs load (status 200, naturalWidth 2000 & 1496), all OG/Twitter/title meta present, og-image.jpg 200. ONE ISSUE remaining: invalid email path shows browser-native tooltip, not [data-testid=contact-error].
rca of the issue: ContactSection.jsx uses <input type="email" ...>. When submitting 'notanemail', the browser fires an invalid input event and short-circuits the form.submit event before React's onSubmit handler runs. As a result, setError('Please enter a valid email.') never executes and [data-testid=contact-error] never mounts. Mitigation: either (a) add `noValidate` prop on the <form> so the JS validator runs, or (b) change the email <input> to type="text" inputMode="email" so the browser doesn't intervene.
